::: {.callout-warning}
This is a prototype post, not an announcement.
:::

A normal update should include a clear title, date, one or two paragraphs, an approved visual when available, and links to the relevant paper, code, slides, or event.

## A small, predictable contribution

1. Copy this `.qmd` file and update the front matter.
2. Write the short update and add descriptive alternative text to every image.
3. Run `quarto preview`, check links and mobile layout, then open a pull request.
4. Ask a colleague to review accuracy, spelling, institutional language, and media permissions.

Quarto automatically adds the approved post to the news grid and RSS feed using its metadata.
